# Inpriv

> Free private email on @inpriv.xyz, with no ads and no trackers: Inpriv Mail is a permanent, end-to-end encrypted mailbox, and Inpriv Temp is a disposable inbox that deletes itself after 24 hours. Open source (MIT).

## Services

- [Inpriv Mail](https://mail.inpriv.xyz/): your own permanent @inpriv.xyz address. Mail between Inpriv users is encrypted in the browser before it leaves it (RSA-2048 and AES-256-GCM); mail from outside senders is encrypted to the user's key as soon as it arrives. The server stores only ciphertext for message bodies.
- [Inpriv Temp](https://temp.inpriv.xyz/): a random disposable address that works instantly, with no account. Mail shows up within seconds. Only the browser that created the inbox can open it (it holds a secret key; the address alone isn't enough). The inbox and its messages are deleted after 24 hours. Temp is not end-to-end encrypted, and an expired address can later be given to someone else, so it isn't meant for accounts you need to keep.
- [Inpriv ID](https://id.inpriv.xyz/): the one account behind Inpriv Mail, with two-factor sign-in (TOTP), recovery codes, a verified recovery email and control over every session.

## Facts

- Price: free.
- Ads and trackers: none. Pages load no third-party scripts, fonts or analytics.
- Stored about users: account details, and an access log (IP, country, network, browser) for sign-ins and account changes, kept 90 days. Never stored: passwords (only salted hashes), private keys, or readable Mail bodies.
- Source code: https://github.com/Inpriv/inpriv
